classification: arithmetic-preserving; integer exact selector only; scorer arithmetic unchanged

gain_criterion_fixed_before_evaluation.long_context: at least 3 percent reduction in the containing committed decode/verification interval for an otherwise matched observer-off serving pair
gain_criterion_fixed_before_evaluation.short_context: no more than 2 percent regression in that containing interval
gain_criterion_fixed_before_evaluation.operator_only: selector speed is diagnostic, never sufficient for keep or promotion
gain_criterion_fixed_before_evaluation.held_out: one compact held-out same-shape case only if the matched long-context pair clears 3 percent
gain_criterion_fixed_before_evaluation.reject: correct but below 3 percent, regressing, or a short-context regression above 2 percent
gain_criterion_fixed_before_evaluation.blocked: missing required exact operator, same-prefix full-model, real exposure, or matched timing evidence
